title: The Coozeball Gazette, Video Edition, Week 9

panel.note: Written in the session by the assistant in the approved newsreel house voice; checked by the code of workflows/script-panel.js and an independent fact and rules check. No judge panel.

sentences.cap: Hot off the wire, Coozeball.
Week 9 brings two upsets and power rankings.
Flash! GioMeow storms to 160.88!
Sunnyvale Green Bastards take it on the chin, by 69.3.
Upset! Number 9 Timoteo nips Number 1 The Mystery Manager by 0.64!
Number 11 Perkis System topples Number 7 haze4daze.
Wanted: The Mystery Manager!
Tank Dell scores 18.5 on the bench.
Josh Downs starts and scores 3.9.
Boom: Jordan Love lands 36.18!
Bust: Mike Washington Jr. posts -0.3 for Timoteo.
Timoteo wins anyway, by a whisker.
In the basement: CaptainFalcon14, with 63.32.
Dumpsterfire007 wins in a walk.
Four teams sit at 6-3, The Carebear Necessities on top.
Power rankings: The Carebear Necessities climb to Number 1, true record 63-36!
haze4daze tumbles from first to fourth.
Next week's Main Event: foe against GioMeow.
The odds give GioMeow 51 percent, by a hair.
The editors regret all errors, and most of your benches.
